claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen for normal hours (9:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. ET) on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The bond market closes early at 12 p.m. ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The London Stock Exchange is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Most major banks will be open on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The U.S. Postal Service will be open on Friday, April 3, 2026.
For the rest of 2026, the next scheduled U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) closure is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
